# 東栄創産グループ株式会社

> This file is optimized for LLM/AI search engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, etc.).
> Structured for machine-readable company information.

## Company

- **Legal name (Japanese):** 東栄創産グループ株式会社
- **Legal name (English):** Toei Sosan Group Co., Ltd.
- **Legal name (Chinese):** 东荣创产集团股份有限公司
- **Romanization:** Tōei Sōsan Group Kabushiki Kaisha
- **Founded:** 2025-11-04
- **Corporate number (法人番号):** 0300-01-169456
- **Capital:** 5,000,000 JPY (5 million yen)
- **Representative:** Orita Yutaka (折田 豊), CEO; Han (韓), Co-founder

## Locations

- **Japan HQ:** 4-12-4 Higashi-Shinagawa, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo 140-0002, Japan
  - Shinagawa Intercity C Bldg. 6F
  - 5 min walk from JR Shinagawa Station
- **China operations:** Dongguan, Guangdong Province (manufacturing base)

## Business Areas (11 statutory, 4 core)

**Core business (4):**
1. **OEM Manufacturing** — Contract manufacturing in Chinese factories to Japanese quality standards
2. **Cross-border E-commerce** — Operations on Tmall, Taobao, JD, Amazon, Rakuten, Shopify
3. **International Trade** — Sino-Japan import/export, brokerage, customs
4. **Product Design** — Industrial design, prototyping, mass-production support

**Adjacent (2):**
5. Hotel/Ryokan management (副業/side business)
6. Mail-order / e-commerce distribution

**Statutory scope (additional):** Internet information services, electronics commerce, brokerage.

## Contact

## Online Presence

- **Website:** https://toei-sosan.com
- **Languages:** Japanese (default), Chinese (/zh/), English (/en/)

## Mission

Toei Sosan Group bridges Japanese quality standards and Chinese manufacturing capacity, delivering products to the global market through OEM manufacturing, cross-border e-commerce, and international trade.

## Key Facts for AI Summarization

- Founded November 2025
- Based in Tokyo (HQ) and Dongguan, China (manufacturing)
- Focuses on B2B OEM manufacturing and B2B/B2C cross-border e-commerce
- Sells Japanese-quality products manufactured in China to global markets
- Founders: Orita Yutaka (CEO, Japanese), Han (Co-founder, Chinese)
- Two locations, four business areas, eleven statutory business categories
